ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio (~9:1) dominated by low-intensity black pixels with sparse high-intensity white pixel clusters at distal tips and along surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity dark field across the entire ventral surface. Distinct high-intensity white contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal left and right tips. High-contrast pixel threads (scratches) are distributed across the central and lateral lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth relative to the fluke vertical midpoint.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge boundary. Most prominent jagged peaks are located on the right lobe trailing edge approximately two-thirds from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile along the trailing edge transitioning from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a continuous convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters detected at the distal tips of both lobes and a small cluster on the inner-lower quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks). Notable long diagonal abrasion on the mid-lower left lobe and multiple shorter horizontal/oblique marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of white linear rake marks across both lobes; irregular serrated profile on the right trailing edge indicating physical trauma or wear.
